Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

cheeky adjective

also saucy, wise guy!, don’t be a wise guy, shameless, what nerve!, what a nerve!, what cheek!, the nerve of him!, wise guy, don’t be a wise guy!

classical

Traupman 350

petulāns, petulantis

declension

Other words

  • impudēns, impudentis — shameless, impudent

    declension · also used · classical · Cic. Rosc. Com. 21: pudēns impudentem (Lewis & Short); Traupman 111: impudēns!; nē sīs impudēns; Traupman 408

  • Ō audāciam! — what nerve! the cheek of it!

    exclamation: the accusative · also used · classical · Ter. Ph. 2.3.13: Ō audāciam! etiam mē ultrō accūsātum advenit? (Lewis & Short s.v. ultrō); Traupman 104: what nerve!, ō audāciam!

    Latin exclaims with the accusative: ō audāciam!, “oh, the boldness!”; so ō rem indignam!, what a shame.

  • improbus, improba, improbum — shameless

    declension · also used · classical · Traupman 157

Examples

  • Nē sīs impudēns.

    Don’t be a wise guy.Traupman 111

  • Impudēns!

    Wise guy!Traupman 408

See also naughty, rascal.
